name: session-limit
description: Warn the model mid-turn as the 5-hour or 7-day limit nears

overage.title: Extra usage enabled
overage.description: Tell the model that requests past an exhausted 5-hour block spend overage credits. Leave off for accounts without extra usage.

muted.title: Mute usage notices
muted.description: Skip usage limit notices on this machine. /limits on turns them back on for one session.
